Anyword Integrations
Connect your tech stack to Anyword and go from Gen-AI
to Gen-AI that drives results.
Performance Context RAG
Inject audience data, channel-specific data, and high-performing talking points into any prompt, ensuring that your Gen-AI content outperforms your baseline prompts by 20%.
Performance Prediction
Set your target audience, distribution channels, and business goals and get performance predictions for any content.
Data Import
Create hyper-personalized content by connecting your CRM to Anyword. Import contact, account, or opportunity information into any prompt.
Performance Data Training
Train Anyword on your historical content performance (ads, social, email, and website) to enhance future content generation and identify opportunities for improvement.
Content Export
Push ready-to-use content directly into your CRM, CMS or marketing channels, for seamless workflows.
